title: Per-player game logs for players on stored official injury reports (R21)
rule: One row per player-game, read verbatim from the archived official box-score pages of Final games. Fields: minutes, points, rebounds, assists and the opponent, plus the team and date. A player or game without an official box-score row is left blank and flagged — never inferred. Name matching is exact after the published normalization (no fuzzy matching).
